products.product_description: The Forest Wild Collection Dark Chocolate bar, CB15052, net wt. 1.25 oz per bar. Product is packaged in a card board box of 12 individually wrapped chocolate bars. Dream Chocolate brand, UPC on each bar is 6 76181 15088 1. Label has the wolf image. The label is read in parts: "***INGREDIENTS: Dark Chocolate (sugar, cocoa liquor, cocoa butter, lecithin - an emulsifier and pure vanilla). CONTAINS: Soy.***This product is manufactured at a plant that processes nut and peanuts***2127 Century Way, Boise, Idaho 83709***".
products.product_quantity: 3 boxes each containing 12/1.25 oz dark chocolate bars
products.code_info: Lot codes S138 and JY238. However these codes are not printed on labels so consumers would not see these codes.
products.reason_for_recall: The 1.25 oz Forest Wild Wolf Dark Chocolate bars are recalled due to undeclared milk
